does: Spoons hot fat or juices over food as it cooks, so that the top browns and stays moist.
how: Tilt the pan so that the fat pools at the near edge.
Scoop it up with a spoon and pour it over the food, again and again.
In a pan, add butter, garlic and thyme near the end and baste with the foaming butter.
For a roast, baste quickly and shut the oven door again.

cues.text: The surface glistens, and browns evenly from edge to edge.
The butter foams and hisses as it runs over the meat. When the foam dies down and darkens, stop.

mistakes.mistake: Basting with butter that has turned dark, which leaves a bitter taste.
mistakes.fix: Add the butter late, and take the pan off the heat when the foam subsides.

mistakes.mistake: Leaving the oven door open while basting a roast, so that the oven loses its heat.
mistakes.fix: Take the tin out, baste, and put it straight back.

comes_after.why: Basting with butter is how a sear ends, once the crust is already there.
